title: plugin-audit + objectql lifecycle: build the audit tamper-evidence ADR — sealer, signed checkpoints, redaction and expiry amendments, `os audit verify`
body:
repo:cloud#3 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZqfEd7pcckjz3pGqn

Filing gate: **③ a task on the maintainer's word.** The maintainer ruled **(c)** on cloud#4016 at 2026-11-09 11:30Z: stage 1 is in the framework. This card builds what the ADR card filed with it decides. Blocked until that ADR merges.

**Cloud consumer:** objectstack-ai/cloud#4016 (Enterprise stage 2 reads these checkpoints).

## 维护者速读

- 问题：同上一张 ADR 卡，审计日志被改被删时证明不了。
- 要做：按 ADR 实现封存器、检查点对象、脱敏和到期删除的修正记录、到期删除按检查点整块删除，以及 `os audit verify`。
- 需要你做的：无。ADR 合并前本卡保持阻塞。

## Work

Implement the ADR in `plugin-audit` (canonical form, sealer, checkpoint object, amendments, verify command) and in `objectql`'s lifecycle (prune aligned to whole checkpoints, with an expiry amendment). The design doc's §2.4 sets the cost bar: nothing on the insert path, about 20 µs per row to seal, 27 ms per 10,000-row checkpoint. A synchronous chain head cut throughput 13.8× at 8 writers per organization, so the sealer must stay asynchronous.

## Done when

On a real kernel with the archive datasource, `os audit verify` reports:
- a row edited through the system context as modified;
- a deleted row as missing;
- a redacted row as redacted, with its amendment;
- a pruned window as expired by policy.

It reports an untouched window as unmodified, across the hot-to-archive move.

## Who acts

The server lane, after the ADR merges.

Dedupe: as on the ADR card.

Related: cloud#4016, cloud PR #4025.
